This host has yt-dlp — for channel/video metadata prefer: `yt-dlp -J --flat-playlist --socket-timeout 10 "<url>"` (the --socket-timeout is what stops it hanging). For page text, captions, or anything yt-dlp's JSON omits, use the serialised-browsing skill.
